name: The Vulture
source:
A tired Fae soldier embarks on a perilous journey to her homeland...but will her final journey be a triumph or lead her to ruin?

[from [url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/the-vulture]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名疲惫不堪的妖精士兵踏上了返回故土的凶险旅途……然而，她的这趟最后征程究竟会迎来凯旋，还是将她引向毁灭？

[摘自[url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/the-vulture]itch.io[/url]]
